author: bardic-inspiration
name: Knight Commander
summary: A veteran commander who leads an entire chapter, fights beside it, and orders strikes on the move.
description: The commander has outlived two lords, a war, and most of the friends who started with them. The men and women under the banner follow without thinking, and the commander is careful about what they are asked to think about.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The commander makes three Greatsword attacks.

bonusActions.name: Rallying Command
bonusActions.text: One ally the commander can see within 30 feet can use its {ref:glossary/reaction} to make one weapon attack with {ref:glossary/advantage} on the attack roll.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The commander is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The commander adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
